title: AS2 compiler: unary + operator does not coerce to number (missing ActionToNumber)
description: Unary +x in compiler.ts only evaluates the operand without emitting ActionToNumber (0x4A). In AS2, +x is equivalent to Number(x). For example, +"3" should produce numeric 3 but leaves the string "3" on the stack, causing subsequent arithmetic to behave as string concatenation. Fix: emit ActionToNumber (0x4A) after compiling the operand in the unary + case.
